EmailTemplate.description: Email for custom price books sent to clients monthly
EmailTemplate.name: PriceBookAttachmentEmailNew
EmailTemplate.subject: {!DATETIMEVALUE(Today())} Price Sheet
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
To Our Valued Customers,
Please see the attachments for the monthly price sheet updates for {!Account.Company_Name__c}, {!Account.ShippingCity}. Pricing is active as of today. Pricing is subject to change at any time without notice.
This is a noreply mailbox and cannot receive orders. Please contact your sales team with questions and orders.
{!Account.Outside_Salesperson__c}
Thank you for considering OmniCable HWC for your stock buy.
